facts.fact: Eravi smears the escort's bark salve on Neela's nail with bare fingertip and his finger does not redden or burn, though resin burns non-odiyan skin; Neela notices and explains it away (cooked salve, horn-skinned hands). Plants Eravi (C-clue).
Neela tells Devan, 'Don't ask me what's in it', because Rema can put him under oath and he cannot lie; he agrees not to ask for three days. She has not told him the salve smells of resin.

Neela's rationalisation: First Guard's single smooth seam and clean-looking throat are not an odiyan's layered ridges, and the crown hangs unvouched odiyans, so she concludes crown men hiding something else.
Kannan says his mother's dog behaved like the hounds when a snake was in the thatch; Bhaskaran says the hounds are only wet.
Three of Neela's nails are split to the quick tonight; Eravi dresses them.
Devan has one 'I won't answer' pass each left from the question game; Neela spends hers on 'what are you'.
